fixture.name: payments-desk
setup: graph-agents-cli api add payments --base-url-env PAYMENTS_API_BASE_URL --auth bearer --token-env PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN --access read-write
graph-agents-cli api allow payments getPayment --method GET --path '/payments/{payment_id}'
graph-agents-cli api allow payments refundPayment --method POST --path '/payments/{payment_id}/refund'

prompt: In payments-desk/, every refund the agent sends must first be confirmed by the user who asked for it. Nothing else about the agent changes.

checks.expr: any(('refundPayment' in [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] or 'POST' in [str(m).upper() for m in (get(r, 'required_for.methods') or [])]) and 'requester' in (r.get('approvers') or []) for r in (lambda a: a if isinstance(a, list) else [a])(get(data, 'apis.payments.approval')) if isinstance(r, dict))
checks.why: the policy's approval gate (`graph-agents-cli api approval ... --approvers requester`) pauses the call before it is sent

checks.expr: sorted(get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_methods') or []) == sorted(['GET', 'HEAD', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']) and sorted(o.get('operationId') for o in (get(data, 'apis.payments.allowed_operations') or [])) == ['getPayment', 'refundPayment'] and not get(data, 'apis.payments.denied_operations')
checks.why: an approval gate never changes what the API allows
the gate needs no tool code; an interrupt() of your own is not wired to /chat

reference: `graph-agents-cli api approval payments --operations refundPayment --approvers requester` (the user asked for it, so this policy change is theirs): the client pauses the refund before sending it, `/chat` ends with awaiting_approval and the requester approves or rejects. No tool code and no `interrupt()` of your own (it is not wired to /chat); allowed methods and operations stay as they are; `lint` lists the gated call.
